data.gender_notes: Minda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Minda was an epithet of the goddess Mnemosyne, meaning memory or mind. This name evokes the idea of a strong and thoughtful woman, one who treasures knowledge and wisdom. The name Minda carries the meaning “Memory, Mind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Minda usually hope their child will grow to embody memory, mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Minda total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Minda has ancient Greek origins, rooted in the word "mind," which means memory or mind. As a result, this name offers a rich cultural connotation, implying depth, thoughtfulness, and intelligence. Historically, Minda was an epithet of the Greek goddess Mnemosyne, the goddess of memory and inspiration. Roman poets used this name as a symbol of intellectual and creative pursuits. In various European cultures, Minda was also used as a given name for girls, further embedding the name's cultural significance within diverse communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Minda is a spiritually meaningful name, as it is derived from the Greek goddess Mnemosyne, the goddess of memory and wisdom. This name carries the essence of knowledge, understanding, and the capacity to store and recall essential information. It also symbolizes the importance of preserving traditions and remembering the past. Minda could be a reminder to nurture the spiritual facet of life by embracing knowledge and wisdom. The name holds deep spiritual significance for those who value the acquisition and application of knowledge and who believe that memories play a vital role in personal growth.
